rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance – coverage (1-4 unit properties exempt)
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents under its Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Municipal Code, which the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers and enforces. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.key_value: 1-4 unit properties exempt; rent increase formula not stated on this page
rules.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code, Chapter 260 (Rent Control Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties of five or more units; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Owners may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request if they meet the criteria for a permitted exemption.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other permitted exemptions in the ordinance, available through a Rent Control Exemption Request (criteria not stated on this page).
rules.interaction: The page does not describe any interaction with a state rent cap.
rules.conflict_note: The page links to a Consumer Price Index chart and lists capital improvement and hardship rent increase applications, but it does not state the rent increase formula.
